tagline: A purpose-built waterfront capital with a Gulf full of single-leg corridors.
summary: Doha pairs a dense, master-planned inner waterfront — the Corniche, West Bay, The Pearl, Lusail and Katara — with an open-Gulf position that puts Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Manama and the Saudi coast within a single hybrid leg. The inner waters are made for all-electric hops; the Gulf is made for long-range hybrids.

use_cases.title: Premium inner-waterfront tier
use_cases.body: A quiet, zero-emission foiling service across Corniche · West Bay · The Pearl · Lusail · Katara — a fast water layer above road congestion.

use_cases.title: Branded on-demand water tier
use_cases.body: In-app premium water trips across the marina-and-island waterfront, plus a flagship Gulf corridor to Dubai/Manama.

use_cases.title: Resort + island shuttle
use_cases.body: The Pearl, Lusail and offshore developments need fast, smooth links — foiling removes the chop and the seasickness.

use_cases.title: West Bay business shuttle
use_cases.body: A repeatable corporate water shuttle between West Bay's towers and the waterfront districts.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Multi-rotation all-electric days across the sheltered inner waterfront — Corniche, West Bay, Pearl, Lusail — with no new charging infrastructure beyond a berth pedestal.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Turns Doha into a Gulf hub: single-leg hybrid corridors to Manama (~99 nm), Abu Dhabi (~175 nm) and Dubai (~196 nm) with no charging-infrastructure dependency.

signature_routes: Corniche ↔ The Pearl ↔ Lusail (all-electric inner network)
transit_planning: For an authority: Navier adds a premium, zero-emission marine layer across the master-planned waterfront and a credible Gulf inter-city corridor — additive to existing transport, with surge capacity for the event calendar.

careem.note: A branded water tier across Doha's waterfront plus the flagship Gulf corridor — first to market.
